headline: Leveraging the solar revolution
description: <p>AT COP31, Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif <a href="https://www.dawn.com/news/2043746">told</a> a high-level dialogue on electrification that “an extraordinary transition has already taken place” in Pakistan: nearly 22 gigawatts of rooftop solar in two years, “a quiet revolution by ordinary citizens seeking affordable power and a cleaner, more predictable future”. More than one in 10 motorcycles sold this year, he added, was electric.</p> <p>He was right to showcase it. Few countries can match that speed. Fewer can accept that their citizens paid for it.</p>

headline: Pakistan's mango exports fall 36pc amid US-Iran war: exporters' association
description: <p>Pakistan’s mango exports fell 36 per cent this year as the <a href="https://www.dawn.com/live/iran-israel-war">US-Iran war</a> disrupted shipping routes and drove up freight costs, industry figures showed on Wednesday.</p> <p>According to All Pakistan Fruit and Vegetables Exporters Association, the country exported 78,000 tonnes of mangoes this year, compared with 123,000 tons last year.</p> <p>Exports to the Middle East, a major market for Pakistani mangoes, dropped from 36,000 tonnes last year to 14,500 tonnes this year, the association said.</
